defaultPrompt: Przeanalizuj wskazane repozytorium GitHub, znajdź problemy i wykonaj wszystkie bezpieczne poprawki autonomicznie.
Doprowadź ten projekt na GitHub do zielonego CI: diagnozuj, poprawiaj, testuj i aktualizuj PR aż pipeline przejdzie.
Zarządzaj tym repozytorium end-to-end z Androida: backlog, branche, PR-y, Actions, bezpieczeństwo i wydania.
interface.longDescription: Cross-platform GitHub automation layer for ChatGPT on Android, web and desktop. It uses the connected GitHub app/connector rather than a packaged desktop-only MCP server. It can inspect and maintain repositories, code, issues, pull requests, branches, releases, Actions/CI/CD, GitHub Pages/Jekyll sites, Projects, security signals and governance to the extent exposed by the connected GitHub app. Reversible work is automated; destructive or high-impact operations require explicit confirmation.

name: github-absolute-automation
description: Cross-platform private GitHub automation plugin for ChatGPT on Android, web and desktop using the connected GitHub app instead of a desktop-only packaged MCP runtime.
